decisions.reason: As a flagship line close to the firm's core safety-footwear capabilities, supported by in-house R&D and a growing market, it fits the firm's knowledge base and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

This electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe is still close to the firm's established offer, so the firm can learn from market feedback and refine it, though its narrower niche makes withdrawal somewhat more plausible than for the flagship lines.
A safety shoe series with several models sits squarely within the firm's existing expertise and broad product range, making continued commercialization more likely than exit.
